objective: Maintain an evidence-based Park MVP delivery plan and acceptance gates, updated with the verified bounded DR24 HATS, API and Workbench browser smoke results as of 2026-11-07.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Park MVP is the primary product delivery track under Issue #158.
DR24 application integration is tracked by Issue #253; PR #264 is a raw-only adapter and remains Draft.
The v0.2.0 scientific baseline, 42-feature contract, class order, benchmark and v1.0.1 software release remain immutable.
CPVS exact reconstruction remains a separate unresolved scientific blocker.
Ordinary CI does not establish source-backed scientific validation.

baseline.description: Documentation-only delivery-control update based on current repository state and Issue #158/#253 plus PR #264. No runtime, model, data, benchmark, feature schema, taxonomy, or scientific threshold changes.

correctness.before: Quick Start, User Guide, Installation, and product roadmap contained stale v1.0.0/v1.0.1 statements or an obsolete 2026-10-11 roadmap.
correctness.after: The delivery plan now distinguishes verified bounded raw HATS retrieval, API live smoke, API failure contracts and Workbench browser smoke from the still-unaccepted 5–10 confirmed-source end-to-end test and 30–50 object guided demonstration.

reliability.reason: This change is documentation-only. It does not implement or test the DR24 runtime path.

reproducibility.before: The Park MVP acceptance scope and staged demonstration gates were spread across issues and audit notes.
reproducibility.after: The plan records workflow IDs, tested object/epoch counts, artifact IDs, and the remaining identity, QC, transformation and replay requirements.

scientific_validity.reason: No new scientific data acquisition, model evaluation, calibration, anomaly evaluation, or source-backed validation was performed.

regression_protection_count.reason: No runtime code or tests changed.

measurement.trade_off: Prioritize accurate Park acceptance criteria and removal of misleading documentation over adding unsupported completion claims.

root_causes: Documentation drift caused the user guide and quick start to describe v1.0.0 after v1.0.1 had been released.
The prior roadmap date and completion claims did not describe the current Park MVP delivery state.
unresolved: No accepted 5–10 confirmed-source end-to-end API/Workbench/QC/export workflow exists yet.
No 30–50 confirmed-source guided Park demonstration or offline rehearsal is verified.
OID-to-physical-source crosswalk, production QC policy, HMJD/photometric transformations and DR24 feature/inference mapping remain unaccepted.
Scientific performance, calibration, abstention, OOD and anomaly validation remain incomplete.
CPVS exact membership remains a separate scientific blocker.

findings: Bounded HATS retrieval, FastAPI live retrieval and Workbench browser interaction each have source-backed smoke evidence for specific OIDs.
Raw source retention, descriptive QC and JSON export have passed the tested browser assertions.
These tests do not establish physical source identity, production QC, scientific feature compatibility, classifier performance or Park acceptance.
The next decisive product gate is a 5–10 confirmed-source complete workflow with a replayable reproducibility bundle.
The Park MVP is the primary delivery track; CPVS and CIN remain separate workstreams outside its critical path.
The Park readiness percentage is intentionally not stated because no defensible weighted measurement basis exists; gate-level evidence is reported instead.

The submitted Park presentation describes a live demo and a scientific anomaly flag; current evidence supports bounded raw DR24 acquisition and component-level API/Workbench behavior only. The addendum explicitly qualifies these claims.
The 5.32-billion figure is the cited DR24 release scale, not the number of light curves processed by this project.
The original institutional PDFs must remain unchanged; any revised submission must be separately versioned and dated.
